missions.name: Obstacle Avoidance
missions.description: Oh no! There's a fallen tree in the road. Find a safe route around it to reach the finish line.
missions.learning_objective: Teaches sequential navigation and the concept of turning to avoid single obstacles.

missions.name: Maze Escape
missions.description: You are trapped in a twisted labyrinth. Plan your moves carefully to construct a path to the exit!
missions.learning_objective: Teaches complex spatial reasoning and multi-step algorithmic planning.

missions.name: Delivery Route
missions.description: The mail needs to be delivered to a series of houses along a very repetivive road. Can you find the lazy way to do it?
missions.learning_objective: Teaches algorithmic efficiency and repeating patterns using the 'Loop' function.
